info.name: UTHANO API
info.description:
UTHANO Farm-to-Home Marketplace REST API - Complete Postman Collection

All endpoints are under /api/v1 prefix.

Authentication: Uses Laravel Sanctum. After login, use the returned token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

Roles:
- Public: No authentication required
- Authenticated: Any logged-in user
- Farmer: Users with 'farmer' role
- Admin/Staff/Warehouse Manager: Users with 'admin', 'staff', or 'warehouse_manager' roles

Variables:
- base_url: API base URL (default: http://localhost:8000/api/v1)
- docker_url: Docker nginx URL (http://localhost:80/api/v1)
- token: Sanctum API token (set after login)
- product_id: Last created product ID
- farmer_id: Last created farmer ID
- farm_id: Last created farm ID
- harvest_id: Last created harvest ID
- warehouse_id: Last created warehouse ID
- inventory_id: Last inventory item ID
- quality_check_id: Last quality check ID
- review_id: Last product review ID
- coupon_id: Last created coupon ID
- packaging_type_id: Last created packaging type ID
- packaging_item_id: Last created packaging item ID
- delivery_agent_id: Last created delivery agent ID
- delivery_zone_id: Last created delivery zone ID
- delivery_id: Last created delivery ID
- order_id: Last created order ID
- notification_id: Last notification ID
- address_id: Last created address ID
- category_id: Last created category ID
- customer_id: Last created customer ID
- audit_log_id: Last audit log ID
- sourcing_id: Last created sourcing record ID
